excludedAlreadyRepresented: HF Kernel Hub 0.16.1 first-class repository migration
deduplication.result: one coordinated non-duplicate HF core-stack compatibility wave

materialChanges: Adds HYV4, VibeVoice, NeoMME/NeoMME-Retriever, Fun-ASR-Nano, KimiLinear and Canary architecture support.
Generation avoids unnecessary accelerator synchronization on every decode step and no longer unconditionally downloads remote Hub files.
Paged-attention invocation without a cache now fails explicitly rather than silently continuing.
Hub-kernel fallback to a slower reference PyTorch implementation is surfaced with a warning and KernelConfig can register standalone functions.
Vision 2D/3D rotary embedding frequency computation is centralized, creating a compatibility obligation for custom vision code.
releases.qualificationBoundary: Framework compatibility only. Already-admitted Hy4 and NeoMME model work is not duplicated; new speech/model families require separate source/license/model qualification before use.

materialChanges: FSDP2 activation checkpointing wraps the matched transformer layer instead of each child, reducing retained activation state at long sequence lengths.
Adds FSDP2 activation checkpoint input offload to pinned CPU memory.
Fixes tied embeddings on torch >=2.13 and FSDP2/PEFT FULL_STATE_DICT adapter shard loss.
Improves DTensor gradient clipping and leaves already-sharded models in place during prepare_model.
Adds full-model disk offload including tied weights and explicit refusal of context parallelism for sliding-window/chunked-attention models.
releases.qualificationBoundary: Training/runtime compatibility only; hardware-specific paths may report UNAVAILABLE and must not be simulated.

materialChanges: Adds a documented runnable path for training sequences beyond one million tokens using chunked_nll, checkpoint offload and YaRN where applicable.
Moves chunked_nll lm_head projection onto bf16 tensor-core execution instead of repeated fp32 materialization.
Vendors fused linear DPO, KTO, GRPO and JSD losses into trl.losses with parity claims against the prior Liger implementation.
Adds vLLM 0.28 support and fail-fast behavior for incompatible/default Async GRPO weight transfer.
Removes PPOTrainer/PPOConfig/value-head legacy APIs and raises dependency floors for PEFT and DeepSpeed.

upstreamEvidenceOnly.example: Qwen3-8B at 1,048,576 tokens on one 8xH100 node
upstreamEvidenceOnly.claimBoundary: Upstream release evidence only; not an SZL benchmark or production qualification.

releases.qualificationBoundary: Post-training compatibility/performance evaluation only. No automatic dependency or training-default promotion.

required: Install/build only from the three pinned release revisions or source-bound release artifacts.
Run deterministic import/API compatibility tests against current Forge training and inference surfaces.
Test FSDP2 activation checkpointing/offload, checkpoint save-load, DTensor clipping and PEFT state handling where hardware permits; report UNAVAILABLE otherwise.
Test TRL chunked_nll, fused-loss parity, long-context configuration validation, vLLM fail-fast behavior and explicit migration handling for removed PPO APIs.
Test Transformers generation no-unconditional-download behavior, cache negative paths, kernel fallback visibility and estate vision-RoPE compatibility.
Record dependency closure, environment, receipts, deterministic outputs and rollback to the prior known-good stack.

alignment.claimBoundary: This wave does not repair or hide existing GitHub -> Hugging Face -> product -> proof drift and does not authorize product/runtime exposure.
